Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رِضًى بِحُكْمِ اللَّهِ
Translation: All praise is for Allah, in satisfaction with the decree of Allah

Arabic text: شَهِدْتُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ قَسَمَ مَعَايِشَ عِبَادِهِ بِالْعَدْلِ
Translation: I bear witness that Allah distributes the livelihoods of His servants with justice

Arabic text: وَ أَخَذَ عَلَى جَمِيْعِ خَلْقِهِ بِالْفَضْلِ
Translation: And He deals with all of His creation with grace

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَفْتِنِّيْ بِمَا أَعْطَيْتَهُمْ
Translation: And do not test me with what You have given them

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَفْتِنْهُمْ بِمَا مَنَعْتَنِيْ فَأَحْسُدَ خَلْقَكَ، وَ أَغْمَطَ حُكْمَكَ
Translation: And do not test them with what You have withheld from me, lest I envy Your creation and disparage Your judgment

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ طَيِّبْ بِقَضَائِكَ نَفْسِي
Translation: And make my soul content with Your decree

Arabic text: وَ وَسِّعْ بِمَوَاقِعِ حُكْمِكَ صَدْرِي
Translation: And expand my chest through the occurrences of Your command

Arabic text: وَ هَبْ لِيَ الثِّقَةَ لِأُقِرَّ مَعَهَا
Translation: And grant me the confidence to acknowledge

Arabic text: بِأَنَّ قَضَاءَكَ لَمْ يَجْرِ إِلَّا بِالْخِيَرَةِ
Translation: That Your decree only flows with what is best

Arabic text: وَ اجْعَلْ شُكْرِيْ لَكَ عَلَى مَا زَوَيْتَ عَنِّي
Translation: And make my gratitude to You for what You have kept away from me

Arabic text: أَوْفَرَ مِنْ شُكْرِيْ إِيَّاكَ عَلَى مَا خَوَّلْتَنِي
Translation: More abundant than my gratitude to You for what You have bestowed upon me

Arabic text: وَ اعْصِمْنِيْ مِنْ أَنْ أَظُنَّ بِذِيْ عَدَمٍ خَسَاسَةً
Translation: And protect me from considering someone of little means as lowly

Arabic text: أَوْ أَظُنَّ بِصَاحِبِ ثَرْوَةٍ فَضْلًا
Translation: Or considering a wealthy person as superior

Arabic text: فَإِنَّ الشَّرِيفَ مَنْ شَرَّفَتْهُ طَاعَتُكَ
Translation: For truly, the noble one is whom Your obedience has ennobled

Arabic text: وَ الْعَزِيزَ مَنْ أَعَزَّتْهُ عِبَادَتُكَ
Translation: And the mighty one is whom Your worship has strengthened

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ مَتِّعْنَا بِثَرْوَةٍ لَا تَنْفَدُ، وَ أَيِّدْنَا بِعِزٍّ لَا يُفْقَدُ
Translation: And provide us with wealth that does not deplete, and support us with honor that is not lost

Arabic text: وَ أَسْرِحْنَا فِيْ مُلْكِ الْأَبَدِ
Translation: And lead us into the eternal kingdom

Arabic text: إِنَّكَ الْوَاحِدُ الْأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ
Translation: Indeed, You are the One, the Unique, the Independent

Arabic text: اَلَّذِيْ لَمْ تَلِدْ وَ لَمْ تُولَدْ
Translation: Who has not begotten nor was begotten

Arabic text: وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَكَ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
Translation: And there is none comparable to You
